_comment: Ready-made rental templates (docs/architecture/RENTAL-container-rental-design.md, section 9). `command` is null: the image's own ENTRYPOINT starts Jupyter and sets up /workspace, so the claim carries no command override. `digest` is the FULL pinned image reference (registry/name@sha256:...) or null until .github/workflows/rental-templates.yml has built the image and scripts/rental_fill_digests.py has written it here. A template without a digest, or whose registry is not allowed, is hidden and refused.

templates.name: PyTorch + JupyterLab
templates.description: A GPU PyTorch environment with JupyterLab and the common training libraries. Your files live in /workspace; put anything you want saved in /workspace/results.

templates.name: Computer vision + JupyterLab (faces, detection, training)
templates.description: PyTorch with JupyterLab plus OpenCV, torchvision, timm, albumentations and face-recognition libraries (facenet-pytorch, insightface, onnxruntime-gpu). Your files live in /workspace; put anything you want saved in /workspace/results.
